objective: Safely navigate intersections by obeying traffic light signals.

missions.description: Stop completely before the white line when the light is red.

trafficRule.title: Stop at Red Lights
trafficRule.description: You must come to a complete stop when the traffic light is red.

missions.description: Proceed through the intersection only when the light is green.

trafficRule.title: Go on Green
trafficRule.description: You may proceed when the light is green, provided the intersection is clear.
